title: The update forces you to spend longer on your phone
body: The purpose of the app is to help you not be on your phone. However, the new update works against that, because you now have way for clicks in the app, which sucks. The worst part is that you can no longer save favourite combinations, so now you have to pick your parameters (tree, label and time) from scratch before planting a tree, which takes way longer. It also now forces you through mandatory clicks after a tree has finished planting, before you can do anything else, which again is totally counter productive to what the app is for…

title: The best productivity app I’ve ever used — and the only one I keep coming back to!
body:
I’ve used Forest for several years now, and I can confidently say it’s hands-down the best timer app out there for staying focused and tracking time. Not only is it super cute (I love planting different trees for different tasks), but it’s also incredibly practical and easy to use.

I use Forest exclusively for work, and I love how simple it is to set up custom tracking systems. I’ve created tags for different types of tasks and assigned specific trees to each one — so by the end of the week, I can see exactly where my time went. It’s really motivating to look back and see that I completed, say, six major tasks, and how many hours I spent on each. It even shows me which time of day I tend to be the most productive, which has been so helpful for planning my workday better.

I’ve tried other productivity and timer apps, but Forest is the only one I’ve stuck with over the years. It’s cute, smart, and makes time-tracking feel fun and rewarding. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to stay focused and feel good about their progress!

title: Great app and you can plant real trees!
body: I love how this app forces you to leave your phone alone, and how it helps you get stuff done, because your phone is no longer a distraction. You earn points and can use them to buy more trees and plants. I got a little bored with buying colourful trees that I could choose to “plant” (because who needs mores than 4-5 pretty trees?) but then I discovered that you can plant real trees with the points you earn, and that makes the app so much more meaningful! I just planted my first real tree, and now I’m just going to keep using the app for the sake of my own productivity and to make the world a better place by helping plant actual trees :)
